notes.title: Mesorift Survival – Big Map Update!
notes.notes:
[p][b]Mesorift Survival – Big Map Update![/b][/p][p]
We’ve massively expanded the map! The classic PvP-survival core remains – but now you’ve got real places to explore:[/p][p]✅ Slum zone with buildings
✅ Hidden underground bunker
✅ Jungle radio tower
✅ Tropical fishing spot by the sea
✅ Canoe docks[/p][p]And this is just the beginning – [b]more locations are on the way[/b]!
We’re excited for the [b]August release[/b] – and thankful for all your feedback![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45649389/aa2a4becab6a738069f95228554006776daa0e2d.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45649389/a2c38eabb2dd80825f802808f30511a5296b1d62.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45649389/433efbfae39fcb46a6cb4630ce1e0e6ce139667e.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45649389/ecfc423142c68466e6a89c8d89a2e5490a122ee3.jpg"][/img][/p]
